ttl.name: Timing Gear Case or Timing Chain Case Oil Seal (2AZ-FE)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 8 clips and the radiator upper air deflector.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Engine Under Cover Rear RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 5 clips and remove the RH rear engine cover.
Using SST, slowly turn the V-belt tensioner clockwise.

item.ptxt: Check that the SST and tools are securely set.
When compressing the V-belt tensioner, slowly apply force perpendicular to the tool, taking 3 seconds or more.

s2.ptxt: Remove the V-belt from each pulley and slowly return the tensioner.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Suspension Member Reinforcement RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and remove the front suspension member reinforcement RH.
Using SST, hold the crankshaft pulley.
Screw the crankshaft pulley bolt into the crankshaft 2 - 3 pitches.
Using SST, remove the crankshaft pulley.

atten3.ptxt: Apply lubricant to the threads and tip of the SST center bolt before use.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Timing Gear Case or Timing Chain Case Oil Seal

s2.ptxt: Using a utility knife, cut off the oil seal lip.
Using a screwdriver wrapped with protective tape, pry out the oil seal.

atten4.ptxt: After removing the oil seal, check that the crankshaft is not damaged. If there are scratches, correct them with sandpaper (#400).
